text:
jess: quick sync: i'm iterating on the right-rail card action strip — noticed button spacing looks inconsistent across dense tables and the standalone card. want to align to a single spacing token and update toasts so they don't overlap actions.

ryan: can you show the delta? feels like we've touched this a bunch.

jess: sure. current: `--space-3` between actions, `--space-4` between row and card edge. proposal: `--space-2` (8px) between buttons, keep `--space-3` around the card. result: compact action groups, same outer padding.

priya: important: action buttons in table rows must not drop below 44px height. when we reduce horizontal gap, label truncation can cause visual imbalance.

omar: +1 on min-height. also for icon-only actions, we should use `button--icon` with 40px min-touch and a focus ring at 3px offset.

jess: sample CSS:```css
.action-strip { display:flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items:center; }
.action-strip .btn { min-height:44px; padding: 0 var(--space-2); }
```handles wrap with `flex-wrap:wrap` and `gap` for spacing.

ryan: wrap behavior matters: when buttons wrap, primary should remain first in DOM and visually remain left-most. do not re-order via DOM.

priya: agreed. reordering with CSS `order` caused focus loss in last sprint. keep DOM order, use visual layout only if necessary. add test for keyboard nav when wrap happens.

omar: about toasts 4e2: on small screens they collide with the action strip if we anchor to bottom-right. propose move toast container to top-right in console, keep a 16px offset from right rail using `--space-3`. newest toast on top, max 4 visible.

jess: top-right makes sense for discoverability on wide dashboards. for mobile, switch to center-bottom full width, and stack vertically with `--space-2` gap.

priya: accessibility: `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` for info toasts, `role="alert"` for errors. ensure screen-reader announces only newest toast, not repeated. Also Esc should dismiss and return focus to the element that triggered the toast.

a11y-bot: note: add color-contrast check for focus ring over the action-strip background when using `--space-2` density. recommended ring color: `--color-focus-strong` (meets 4.5:1).

ryan: copy nit: action label alignment 4dd. we use sentence case elsewhere; keep that. e.g., `Try again` not `TRY AGAIN`.

jess: good catch, i'll normalize labels. also renaming dismiss button on toasts to `Dismiss` to match other controls.

omar: visual diffs: https://deploy-preview.redwood/design/action-strip-compact — compare dense table vs card layout.

priya: i'll run the NVDA + VoiceOver flows on the branch tonight and flag any issues. include test steps: focus sequence through row actions, open toast, ensure announcement, press Esc, focus restored.

jess: plan: i'll push token PR (`--space-2` adoption) and update the component docs with examples for table rows, card actions, and mobile wrap. freeze if no a11y regressions. thanks! :raised_hands:
